steps.prompt: A cute low round toy bush made of clustered rounded leaf-green foliage blobs, wider than tall. Photograph of a real hand-painted wooden and sculpted clay toy miniature made for a tabletop diorama, smooth rounded sanded forms, glossy enamel paint with subtle brush strokes, soft macro studio lighting, high detail. Single isolated object, the entire object in frame with margin, centered, three-quarter front view from slightly above, even soft studio lighting, no cast shadow, plain light-grey seamless background. No text, no logos, no lettering, no numbers, no brand marks, no emblems anywhere on the object.
